intents.statement: Find streams of large, recurring, physical-world money trapped behind broken proof, trust, and settlement infrastructure. Map the participants. Build the substrate that removes the friction dam. The business compounds because every participant becomes more capable, more trusted, more eligible, and easier to transact with inside the rail. The moat strengthens because the market gets healthier. Win the wedge. Expand to the operating system. Every answer should serve this architecture.

intents.title: Prove one external verified outcome before expanding the platform
intents.statement: Among the credible branches the path that most increases expected founder advantage is to prove one external Verified Outcome before expanding the platform, because it creates owned proof acceptance rather than software usage. General-platform-first, content-first and marketplace-replacement-first either burn capital before proof, leave bypass paths open, or create operational liabilities before the control plane is real.
intents.source: Proof-to-Settlement Egregore analysis, endorsed in direction by the founder
intents.intended_outcome: Sequencing pressure stays on the first reconciled external outcome rather than on further internal breadth.
intents.rationale: Recorded at advisory authority on purpose. The founder placed the document in the intent hierarchy as *supporting* fail-closed, capability-bound, evidence-reconciled execution, which endorses its direction and does not ratify each sentence as executable law. Promoting an analysis to an active requirement is the specific move the founder's hierarchy warns against. It is recorded because it independently converges with an already-implemented kernel invariant: HARDENED requires a reconciled external consequence and nothing internal can supply one.
evidence_refs: blueprint/ladder.py: EXTERNAL_OUTCOME is required only at HARDENED and resolves for nothing
python -m blueprint.cycle: the CEREMONY_SUSPECTED verdict exists to detect internal breadth that unlocks nothing
intents.next_review_trigger: Founder ratifies or rejects the sequencing claim, or the first verified outcome lands.
unresolved_questions: The vertical named in the source document was explicitly not imported into the current decision; only its generally applicable proof and containment principles were used.

intents.statement: Do not let DALEOBANKS or any frontier model sit directly on the settlement path. Sensing and narrative organs feed signals; strategy and underwriting evaluate; the control plane authorizes; settlement happens behind the consequence boundary.
intents.source: Proof-to-Settlement Egregore analysis, endorsed in direction by the founder
intents.intended_outcome: Settlement authority never becomes reachable from a perception organ or from model output.
intents.rationale: Recorded at advisory rather than constitutional authority because it comes from an analysis the founder endorsed in direction, not from a founder statement of law. Ratifying it as a constitutional invariant requires an explicit founder statement. It is proposed for ratification because it is checkable: it can be expressed as an executable guard over the organ manifests and the gate, which no current test asserts.
